recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-14357 unless the Imaging work group later opens a new change request for a different availability model.
issue_request: FHIR-14357 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 ImagingStudy. It asked how to handle online/offline availability when the same study is available from multiple endpoints; the resolution removed ImagingStudy.availability from both study and series and added implementation notes saying systems can determine study, series, or instance availability by interacting with the endpoint.
initial_application: Historical commit 7b2b645120 references GF#14357 in an ImagingStudy change set. It marked ImagingStudy.availability and ImagingStudy.series.availability as removed in the then-authoritative spreadsheet source, removed availability values from examples, and added the endpoint/offline implementation-note sentence.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Current source contains ImagingStudy.endpoint and ImagingStudy.series.endpoint but no ImagingStudy.availability or ImagingStudy.series.availability elements or example availability values. FHIR-14358, raised in the same endpoint/availability context, resolved no-change for making ImagingStudy per endpoint. Later FHIR-50775 updated ImagingStudy descriptions without restoring availability elements.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies both substantive requirements: the availability elements are absent and the endpoint interaction note is present in source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml.
